note: The one written field on this site. Every other value in data/ is extracted from a review or computed in code; these sentences are model-written from the pattern's own evidence, the same way extraction is a prompted step rather than an API call in the build. See scripts/gap-prompt.md. A pattern with no entry here simply shows no gap line.

Crashes and stability.line: Every workaround reviewers found is reinstall or restart. Nothing offers recovery that preserves what was in progress.

Pricing and billing.line: Reviewers escape to the app store for refunds. Nothing surfaces trial conversion or refund status inside the app.

Ads and interruptions.line: The only workaround is force-quitting. Nothing lets people turn off an interruption they did not ask for.
